description: This file implements FastAPI routes for role adjacency-related operations in a role management system. It provides endpoints to suggest adjacent roles and to show detailed role adjacency information, combining external mapping service calls with local database fallback logic.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] _required_map_by_role_id(db: Session, role_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves required competency levels for a given role ID from the database.

methods.name: float _weighted_jaccard(map_a: Dict[str, int], map_b: Dict[str, int])
methods.description: Calculates the weighted Jaccard similarity score between two competency maps.

methods.name: AdjacentRolesResponse _local_adjacent_roles( db: Session, role_name: str, limit: int, min_score: float )
methods.description: Computes adjacent roles locally based on database mappings as fallback.

methods.name: AdjacencyDetailsResponse _local_adjacency_details( db: Session, current_role: str, target_role: str )
methods.description: Provides detailed adjacency information locally based on database data as fallback.

methods.name: AdjacentRolesResponse get_role_adjacency( role: str = Query(..., description="Role name (or numeric ID as a fallback)"), limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=50, description="Maximum results to return"), min_score: float = Query(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="Minimum similarity score threshold"), _: object = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to get suggested adjacent roles, prioritizing external service with local fallback.

methods.name: AdjacencyDetailsResponse get_role_adjacency_details( current_role: str = Query(..., description="Current role name"), target_role: str = Query(..., description="Target role name"), _: object = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Endpoint to get detailed adjacency between two roles, with external service and local fallback.
